Risk_Statement: An employee account could be compromised, allowing unauthorized access to email and connected services.
Vulnerability_or_Gap: MFA coverage and phishing reporting are not confirmed for every account.
Existing_Controls: Password policy; basic user awareness reminders.
Recommended_Action: Enforce MFA on all accounts; run short awareness sessions; review sign-in alerts.

Risk_Statement: An attacker could exploit an unpatched laptop and gain a foothold in the company environment.
Vulnerability_or_Gap: No centralized evidence of patch compliance or exception tracking.
Existing_Controls: Operating system updates are enabled on most laptops (assumption).
Recommended_Action: Create monthly patch reports and define remediation deadlines for critical updates.

Risk_Statement: Ransomware could disrupt operations if backup copies are unavailable or cannot be restored.
Vulnerability_or_Gap: Backup restoration testing and isolation are not documented.
Existing_Controls: Scheduled backups are reported to exist (fictional scenario assumption).
Recommended_Action: Perform documented restore tests; restrict backup administration; protect an offline or immutable copy.

Risk_Statement: A user with excessive permissions could view or export customer/order information without a business need.
Vulnerability_or_Gap: Access reviews are not performed on a documented schedule.
Recommended_Action: Review roles quarterly and remove access promptly after role changes or termination.

Risk_Statement: An outage or security incident at a critical service provider could interrupt online sales.
Vulnerability_or_Gap: Vendor security review and continuity arrangements are not consistently documented.
Recommended_Action: Maintain vendor contacts, review security commitments, and document a manual order/continuity procedure.
